The /api/public/* endpoints work without a key at 60 requests per hour per IP. Send a personal key (create one on your profile, Security tab) as Authorization: Bearer <api-key> for 1,000 requests per hour per key; an invalid, revoked or expired key is rejected with 401.

Each operation documents whether it requires the session cookie or an Authorization: Bearer <api-key> header. Validation errors use the field-level { "error": "validation_failed", "message": string, "fieldErrors": object, "errors": array } envelope. Rate-limit state is exposed via RateLimit-* response headers.
